title: I'm Through with White Girls

infobox.Release date: February 2007 (2007-02) (Los Angeles Pan African Film Festival)

release_dates: February 2007 (2007-02) (Los Angeles Pan African Film Festival)

text.lead: I'm Through with White Girls (The Inevitable Undoing of Jay Brooks) is a 2007 independent romantic comedy film starring Anthony Montgomery and directed by Jennifer Sharp. The film was shot in Los Angeles over the course of twenty-four days.
text.plot: Jay Brooks (Montgomery), a black man, vows to give up dating white women in favor of dating black women, only to fall in love with a biracial woman.
text.cast:
- Anthony Montgomery as Jay Brooks
- Ryan Alosio as Matt McKenzie
- Lia Johnson as Catherine Williamson
- Lisa Brenner as Molly
- Johnny Brown as Sam Moore
- Jeff Wadlow as Billy
- Alaina Reed Hall as Jerri Hall
- Lamman Rucker as Drake Moore
- Kellee Stewart as J.C. Evans
- Lynn Chen as Candace
